subject: Assurance addendum: log-horizon change + capacity uplift proposal (BrightPay)
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@brightpay.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rudd <tom.rudd@brightpay.com>, BrightPay Legal <legal@brightpay.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal - request for assurance addendum and extended log horizon

Marcus —

As we start our renewal discussion for next quarter I wanted to flag two items the security team and procurement want baked into the renewal:

1) SOC 2 supplemental language confirming the control mappings for third-party logging (S3/CloudAudit) and confirm we can get an evidence bundle during re-attestation.
2) A change in the log retention horizon from 12 months to 24 months for audit logs and authentication events. This may be a contractual amendment or a supplemental addendum — legal will advise.

We’re evaluating a capacity bump too (peak throughput during month-end payroll runs) so we may combine the retention addendum with a dedicated capacity uplift. Can your team share a proposal and what evidence you can provide for the SOC 2 re-attestation?

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morales
Head of IT Risk, BrightPay
---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightpay.com>
Cc: Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal - request for assurance addendum and extended log horizon

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the heads-up. We can support both asks but want to align on a few operational constraints before we put a formal amendment on the table:

- Evidence: we can provide a scoped re-attestation support bundle (control mappings, sample logs, and SOC 2 workpapers) during the normal recert cycle; if BrightPay needs an out-of-cycle collection we’ll map the requested artifacts and turnaround.
- Retention: 24 months for audit logs is feasible but has cost and storage implications. I’ll include a retention impact calc and a pricing delta.
- Capacity: we can propose a Dedicated pool uplift with a phased burst plan for month-end payroll.

Are you available for a 30-minute sync later this week so we can capture legal asks and timelines? I’ll loop in our security and legal leads once we have a call.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0189

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal - request for assurance addendum and extended log horizon

Team —

Forwarding BrightPay’s note (below). Key asks: 24mo log retention for audit logs/auth events, SOC2 evidence bundle for re-attestation, and likely a Dedicated capacity uplift tied to month-end throughput.

Kim: can you draft a supplemental assurance addendum and indicate whether we can accept 24 months as a standard carveout vs. a paid add-on?
Jordan / Connor: need your ops input on retention feasibility, expected storage delta, and whether we should recommend caching/batch changes to reduce cost. Also, if we offer a 6- or 12-month committed uplift pricing, what is the lead time and can we guarantee month-end burst?

Goal: get a consolidated proposal to Elena by Dec 15 so BrightPay can route to legal and procurement.

Thanks —
Marcus

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal - request for assurance addendum and extended log horizon

Marcus / all —

Preliminary legal notes after an initial pass:

- We can produce a short-form "Assurance Addendum" (2-3 clauses) that specifically references SOC 2 control mappings and the types of artifacts Redwood will provide during normal recertification. Out-of-cycle evidence requests will be accommodated but treated as professional services/effort with an SLA and cost table.
- For the retention change: 24 months is not prohibited. We need to add a retention schedule exhibit enumerating scope (audit logs, auth events only), responsible party for encryption/key lifecycle, and a pricing delta tied to monthly GB stored.
- I’ve prepared a draft DocuSign-ready addendum and a clause that allows for an optional Dedicated capacity ramp with defined throughput SLAs and a fallback to hosted variants if capacity shortfalls occur.

I’ll attach the draft DocuSign and a retention-impact workbook — Jordan, can you validate the numbers and fill in the throughput targets?

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Deputy GC, Redwood Inference
Attachments: DocuSign-Assurance-Addendum-BP-3749.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 15:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal - request for assurance addendum and extended log horizon

Team —

Retention-impact calc (attached as a stub) shows:
- Incremental storage for 24mo retention on current BrightPay audit/event volumes: ~4.6 TB active/nearline (estimate).
- Monthly storage delta: ~0.42 TB/mo, estimated incremental monthly cost -> see workbook.
- Throughput uplift: recommending a Dedicated pool sized for 1.8x current steady-state with a month-end burst policy of +2.5x for 48 hours. Lead time: 14 days to provision Dedicated nodes with confirmable SLA.

Ops caveats: longer retention increases snapshot restore window and egress surface for evidence collection. We should include a short playbook for evidence extraction during recert (list of sample queries, export format, timeframe). Marissa — can you draft the playbook section for the client? Connor — please flag anything that would break retention encryption or key rotation policies.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Customer Reliability Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Retention-Impact-Calc-BrightPay.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightpay.com>
Cc: Tom Rudd <tom.rudd@brightpay.com>, BrightPay Legal <legal@brightpay.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 16:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Assurance addendum + retention pricing and Dedicated uplift (proposal)

Elena —

Thanks for your patience while we pulled the technical, legal, and ops details together. Attached are three artifacts: (1) RI-SOC2-Supplemental-FAQ-v1.pdf — clarifies control mappings and what we supply during re-attestation; (2) Retention-Impact-Calc-BrightPay.xlsx — line-item storage and cost delta for 24mo retention; (3) DocuSign-Assurance-Addendum-BP-3749.pdf — the proposed addendum for signature.

Summary of the proposal:
- Assurance Addendum: scoped to SOC 2 control families for logging and authentication. Normal recertification evidence collection is included; ad-hoc/out-of-cycle evidence collections are billable per the attached fee schedule.
- Retention: we can extend audit/auth event retention to 24 months for the scoped artifacts. Estimated incremental cost: +$1,950/month (approx) based on current volumes — see workbook.
- Dedicated uplift: 6-month committed uplift (1.8x steady-state with 48h month-end burst to 2.5x) priced at $6,500/month with immediate provisioning lead time of 14 days. We can convert to a 12-month upfront credit for a 10% discount if BrightPay prefers.

Next steps we propose:
1) BrightPay legal review and DocuSign signature of the addendum (link below).
2) Confirm capacity option (6 vs 12 months). 3) Kickoff for evidence-playbook and a short dry-run (we can schedule the dry-run the week after signature).

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/SigningLink/abc123-brightpay
Drive folder (evidence playbook + artifacts): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_example_aff4

If this looks good, we’ll prepare a statement of work for ad-hoc evidence requests and a short-run onboarding plan for Dedicated nodes.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
